user.title: Connect a Tholz Fairland heat pump
user.description: Enter the account e-mail and password. Setup signs in, lists compatible heat pumps, and validates a read-only request before storing credentials. The password is kept in the Home Assistant entry and in backups that include it.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Tholz Fairland
reauth_confirm.description: The stored cloud session is no longer valid. Sign in again; credentials are saved only after a valid device read.

challenge.title: Complete the sign-in challenge
challenge.description: The account requires an additional verification step. Enter the requested value to finish signing in.

reconfigure.title: Update Fairland credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the account e-mail and password again. Existing credentials are replaced only after successful authentication and a valid device read.

select_device.title: Select the heat pump
select_device.description: Choose the compatible heat pump to add.

error.cannot_connect: Could not authenticate or read the device. No device command was sent.
error.invalid_token: The cloud session was rejected. Enter fresh credentials.
error.invalid_auth: The account e-mail or password was rejected.
error.unsupported_challenge: This account needs a sign-in step that cannot be completed here. Finish signing in with the vendor app, then try again.
error.challenge_failed: The verification value was not accepted. Try again.
error.configuration_error: The cloud configuration is incomplete or inconsistent.
error.wrong_account: The account signed in does not match this device. Nothing was changed.
error.no_devices: No compatible Fairland heat pump was found in this account.

abort.already_configured: This Fairland device is already configured.
abort.configuration_error: The configuration flow lost required state. Start again.

init.title: Tholz Fairland options
init.description: The polling frequency takes effect after the integration reloads. Credentials are changed through reauthentication or Reconfigure, not here.
